facts.text: Park Hotel Kenmare is set on the shores of Kenmare Bay in County Kerry, a short stroll from the town of Kenmare.
facts.excerpt: Set on the shores of Kenmare Bay in County Kerry, Park Hotel Kenmare is just a short stroll from the colourful town of Kenmare

facts.text: The hotel has views across Kenmare Bay to the Caha Mountains.
facts.excerpt: with views across the bay to the Caha Mountains

facts.text: Park Hotel Kenmare has welcomed guests since 1897 and was initially constructed as a railway hotel.
facts.excerpt: Park Hotel Kenmare has been welcoming guests from around the world since 1897. Initially constructed as a railway hotel

facts.text: The hotel has a private art collection featuring works by artists including Sean Scully, Andy Warhol and Callum Innes.
facts.excerpt: home to an acclaimed private art collection featuring works by artists including Sean Scully, Andy Warhol and Callum Innes

facts.text: The hotel hosts daily art tours open to hotel guests as well as visitors.
facts.excerpt: we are hosting daily art tours open to guests of the hotel as well as visitors

facts.text: Owners Bryan and Tara Meehan arrived at Park Hotel Kenmare in 2023.
facts.excerpt: Since their arrival at Park Hotel Kenmare in 2023, owners Bryan and Tara Meehan have introduced an expansive collection of internationally acclaimed art.

facts.text: All guest rooms and suites were completely renewed, with the work completed in 2026.
facts.excerpt: Following the complete renewal of all guest rooms and suites, completed in 2026

facts.text: Bathrooms have been upgraded with Italian marble and underfoot heating.
facts.excerpt: Bathrooms have been fully upgraded with italian marble and underfoot heating

facts.text: The Landscape Suites were designed by Jo Nagasaka of Schemata Architects, Tokyo.
facts.excerpt: designed by Jo Nagasaka of Schemata Architects, Tokyo

facts.text: The Forever Begin suite is inspired by Brendan Kennelly's poem Begin.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by Brendan Kennelly's celebrated poem Begin

facts.text: Landscape, the hotel's spa, has a lap pool, spa treatments by Susanne Kaufmann and Seabody, outdoor baths, sauna and steam.
facts.excerpt: Alongside the 25-metre lap pool, guests can enjoy spa treatments by Susanne Kaufmann and Seabody, wellness technology therapies, outdoor baths, sauna and steam

facts.text: The spa includes a Technogym fitness room and a yoga and Pilates studio with Reformer and Cadillac.
facts.excerpt: Our Spa includes a Technogym fitness room, a yoga and pilates studio with both Reformer and Cadillac.

facts.text: The hotel is situated on 12 acres of gardens, including a herb garden, a croquet lawn and tennis courts.
facts.excerpt: The Park Hotel Kenmare is situated on 12 acres of expansive gardens. Guests are welcome to wander through the grounds, which include an abundant herb garden frequented by both the bees and our chefs, a croquet lawn and tennis courts

facts.text: Through the gates of the grounds is Reenagross Park, where guests can dip their toes into the Kenmare River.
facts.excerpt: Continue through the gates to Reenagross Park, where trees grow every which way and you can dip your toes into the Kenmare River.

facts.text: The hotel is a member of Relais & Châteaux and Ireland's Blue Book and has received Two Michelin Keys.
facts.excerpt: A member of Relais & Châteaux and Ireland's Blue Book, and the recipient of Two Michelin Keys

facts.text: Landline, the hotel restaurant, takes its name from a Sean Scully piece and celebrates food from where the land meets the sea.
facts.excerpt: Landline, taking its name from a Sean Scully piece, celebrates food from where the land meets the sea.

facts.text: Landline is led by Executive Chef James O'Sullivan and celebrates seasonal produce from Kerry and the surrounding region.
facts.excerpt: Led by Executive Chef James O'Sullivan, the restaurant celebrates the very best seasonal produce from Kerry and the surrounding region

facts.text: The hotel is a base for exploring the Ring of Kerry, the Beara Peninsula and the Wild Atlantic Way.
facts.excerpt: the perfect base for exploring the Ring of Kerry, the Beara Peninsula and the Wild Atlantic Way

facts.text: Kerry Airport is located 40 km from Kenmare.
facts.excerpt: Kerry Airport, located 40 km from Kenmare

facts.text: Children are welcome at the 6.30pm seating in Landline; later seatings are reserved for adult guests.
facts.excerpt: We welcome children at our 6.30pm seating in Landline. Later seatings are reserved for adult guests.

facts.text: Activities from the hotel include fishing, hiking, boat trips, climbing Carrauntoohil and golfing.
facts.excerpt: from fishing to hiking, Boat Trips, climbing Ireland highest mountain Carrauntoohil to golfing and more

facts.text: The hotel has a year-round wood burning fireplace.
facts.excerpt: retained the charm, year-round wood burning fireplace, eccentricity, and elegance it was built with

facts.text: Rooms have a complimentary minibar stocked on arrival.
facts.excerpt: Complimentary minibar stocked on arrival
